roleTitle: Finance Operations Analyst, Logistics Delivery Services
jobDescription: The logistics delivery services division of a parcel carrier settles weekly payments to its contracted delivery partners. The Finance Operations Analyst owns the partner settlement run, holds the release authority for the weekly payment file within a delegated limit, leads the settlement review with partner management, and is accountable to the divisional finance manager for settlement accuracy. The role sits in divisional finance, works daily with partner management and accounts payable, and covers roughly 1,100 contracted partners across the division's depots.
requirements: Owns the weekly partner settlement run and holds release authority for the payment file within a delegated limit.
Maintains the settlement rules and rate tables in the settlement tool.
Leads the weekly settlement review with partner management and records decisions.
Coordinates disputes with partner management and accounts payable and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions after each settlement run.

evidence.text: Owned the weekly partner settlement run for the delivery division for two years, releasing the payment file to accounts payable under my delegated release authority of 400,000 per run, with runs above the limit co-released by the divisional finance manager.
Maintained the settlement rules and the partner rate tables in the settlement tool, logging every rate change with the contract reference and the effective date.
Led the weekly settlement review with partner management, deciding which disputed items were held back and recording the decisions in the review log.
Coordinated partner disputes with partner management and accounts payable, recording that partner management owned the relationship conversation while I owned the settlement decision.
Responsibilities included settlement-run ownership, payment-file release within limit, rule maintenance and the settlement review for the delivery division over about two years.

Work sample: the release log showing payment files released under the candidate's user id with amounts and the review log for one month, with the settlement tool's run identifiers as a verification trail.
Reference call with the former divisional finance manager: confirmed the candidate owned the settlement run, held the 400,000 release limit and led the weekly review; confirmed employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is available for a settlement-process walkthrough next week; notice period is six weeks.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions after each settlement run are only partly documented in the review log.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: release within the 400,000 limit and the settlement review; runs above the limit were co-released by the divisional finance manager.
